verdict.rationale: Superset is documented as local-first: agents run on your own machine, the CLI manages a 'local host server', and code never leaves the machine unless you choose otherwise. There are also hints of multi-host and remote operation (a selected host's GitHub CLI login, 'Remote access' on the paid tier, and a community mention of remote workspaces), but nothing explicitly says you can run hosts on your own VMs or in containers. Missing for 10: documented container deployment, explicit self-hosted VM/remote-host setup docs, and independent corroboration of running hosts on your own infrastructure.
